text_block_list.text:
King Halo splendidly managed to leave her 
mark in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, what are you spacing out for?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of a meeting right 
now, you know? Could you straighten up a 
bit?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. And here we are, without even 
a moment to rest.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Once spring returns, it'll be GⅠ race 
season. As a top-class Umamusume, I have 
to achieve great success, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: Who do you mean by them?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"To all of you who look forward to the 
path we forge—"
